# clumio_gcs_bucket (Data Source)

clumio_gcs_bucket data source is used to retrieve details of the GCS buckets for use in other resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "clumio_gcs_bucket" "example" {
  bucket_names = ["my-gcs-bucket", "another-bucket"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_names` (Set of String) The list of GCS bucket names to be queried.

### Read-Only

- `gcs_buckets` (Attributes Set) The GCS buckets matching the given bucket_names. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gcs_buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--gcs_buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gcs_buckets`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_name` (String) The name of the GCS bucket.
- `created_timestamp` (String) Creation time of the bucket in RFC-3339 format.
- `id` (String) The Clumio-assigned ID of the GCS bucket.
- `is_deleted` (Boolean) Determines whether the bucket has been deleted.
- `is_versioning_enabled` (Boolean) Determines whether versioning is enabled for the bucket.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) The GCP labels associated with the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gcs_buckets--labels))
- `last_backup_timestamp` (String) Time of the last backup in RFC-3339 format.
- `location` (String) The GCP location associated with the bucket.
- `location_type` (String) The location type of the bucket (e.g., "Region", "Dual-region", "Multi-region").
- `location_uuid` (String) The Clumio-assigned UUID of the GCP location associated with the bucket.
- `object_count` (Number) The number of objects in the bucket.
- `organizational_unit_id` (String) The Clumio-assigned ID of the organizational unit associated with the bucket.
- `project_id` (String) The GCP project ID associated with the bucket.
- `project_uuid` (String) The Clumio-assigned UUID of the GCP project associated with the bucket.
- `protection_group_count` (Number) The number of protection groups associated with the bucket.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Total size in bytes of all objects in the bucket.

<a id="nestedatt--gcs_buckets--labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gcs_buckets.labels`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The GCP label key.
- `value` (String) The GCP label value.
